summaries.en: Hummingbot is an open-source framework for building and deploying algorithmic trading bots in cryptocurrency markets, addressing the need for automated, high-frequency trading strategies accessible to developers and traders. Its technical strength lies in modular architecture using Python and Cython, enabling custom strategy development with real-time market data processing and exchange connectivity. Users can implement arbitrage, market-making, or trend-following strategies across centralized and decentralized exchanges, with backtesting capabilities to validate approaches before live deployment.
summaries.zh: Hummingbot是一个开源框架，专门用于构建和部署加密货币市场的算法交易机器人，解决了开发者和交易者对自动化高频交易策略的需求。其技术核心采用Python和Cython的模块化架构，允许用户开发自定义策略，实时处理市场数据并连接多个交易所。通过该工具，您可以实现套利、做市或趋势跟踪等策略，支持中心化和去中心化交易平台，并具备回测功能以验证策略有效性，适合想要探索自动化交易或研究市场微观结构的实践者。

summaries.en: Seerr is an open-source media request manager that solves the problem of fragmented media discovery across different platforms by centralizing requests for Jellyfin, Plex, and Emby. Its technical strength lies in integrating with automation tools like Radarr and Sonarr to automatically fetch requested content, streamlining the entire media acquisition workflow. Users can deploy it via Docker to create a unified request portal where community members can suggest movies or shows, which then trigger automated downloads and library updates.
summaries.zh: Seerr是一款开源媒体请求管理器，它解决了用户在Jellyfin、Plex和Emby等不同媒体平台上发现内容分散的痛点。该项目通过集成Radarr和Sonarr等自动化工具，实现了请求内容的自动获取和整理，展示了如何用轻量级接口连接多个系统的设计思路。用户可通过Docker快速部署，为家庭或团队创建统一的媒体请求门户，社区成员可在此推荐影视内容，系统会自动触发下载并更新媒体库，让媒体管理变得智能而高效。

summaries.en: Build-Your-Own-X is a curated collection of tutorials that teaches programming by recreating technologies from scratch, helping developers understand system internals through hands-on implementation. Its technical insight lies in breaking down complex systems into learnable components, demonstrating how foundational concepts combine to create sophisticated tools. You can use it to build anything from databases to games, gaining practical skills while exploring how your favorite tools work under the hood—perfect for deepening your programming knowledge through active creation.
summaries.zh: Build-Your-Own-X 是一个精心编排的教程集合，通过从零开始复现各种技术来教授编程，帮助开发者通过动手实践理解系统内部原理。其核心方法是将复杂系统分解为可学习的组件，展示基础概念如何组合成复杂工具的技术思路。你可以用它构建从数据库到游戏的各种项目，在探索常用工具底层原理的同时获得实用技能——这种“边做边学”的方式非常适合想要通过主动创造来深化编程理解的开发者，为技术成长提供了一条清晰的实践路径。
